report.summary: Audited frozen range 49b67a30→889b18d1 (D1: Copy All on the local HTML report) strictly from the frozen manifest at executor-runs/f1b8f3ba. Scope: 9 changed paths (tradingagents/report_html.py, tests/test_report_html.py, plan, acceptance doc, proof JSON, audit skill + 3 templates), all accounted for in the frozen diff; the committed governing requirements match the plan's commit-on-branch mandate. Feature acceptance: SUPPORTED by frozen evidence. The implementation matches every material D1 requirement: CSP tightened to default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src '<sha256-hash>' with the hash derived from the exact _COPY_SCRIPT bytes; the Copy All button is the masthead's first child with the prescribed markup/styling (plus a benign aria-live addition) and is hidden in print; the payload is built from a rendered off-screen clone of #top with buttons, scripts, logo and 'Top' controls removed and duplicate ids stripped, preserving reading order from ticker/rating through the credit to the complete operational assessment; clipboard.writeText with a plain-text textarea/execCommand fallback never writes HTML, reports success only on an actual write, and shows a manual-copy message otherwise; repeat clicks are guarded. Replaced tests enforce exactly one fixed inline script, CSP hash recomputed from emitted bytes, no URLs/fetch/import in the script, and no external assets; hostile-content escaping tests are retained. The committed proof JSON and acceptance record both-browser (Safari 26.5, Chrome 156) file:// proofs: normal, denied, unavailable, final double-click (per-browser byte-identical text/plain payloads beginning 'DOCN / Underweight' and ending 'Full operational audit: ./operational_audit.md', controls excluded) and both-fail with no false 'Copied'. Full-suite (3101 passed/10 skipped) and Ruff results are builder-supplied receipts at e87843e4, consistent with the frozen source hashes recorded in the proof JSON. Merge-integrity verdict: coherent — diff, changed paths and manifest base/head agree. Full-suite-health verdict: green per builder receipts only, not independently executed. Remote-CI verdict: not applicable/unverified — local unpushed candidate with publication explicitly deferred per plan boundaries. No blocking (Critical/High/Medium) in-scope finding was identified; two low-severity non-blocking observations are recorded below.
limitations: Frozen-evidence-only audit: no test execution, lint run, browser interaction, or repository/network access was performed; full-suite (3101 passed), red-test baseline, Ruff, and all browser-proof results are builder-supplied receipts recorded in the committed acceptance doc and proof JSON.

Could not independently recompute the proof JSON's core_script_sha256 (00e95af7…) or the CSP base64 hash from the frozen _COPY_SCRIPT bytes because the sandbox rejected hashing/scripting pipelines; the binding check (CSP hash computed from actual emitted script bytes) is instead enforced by the committed test, whose logic was inspected and is correct by construction.

Denied/unavailable/both-fail clipboard cases were exercised in builder-modified proof-envelope HTML copies (core script bytes stated unchanged, per-envelope CSP hashes), not the exact shipped file; disclosed in the acceptance and mitigated by the final normal-path proof on original product bytes.

Safari clipboard paste was inspected via the Chrome-hosted inspector because Safari's local-file sandbox denied the scratch inspector (shared system clipboard; disclosed); no mobile or printed-output runtime proof is claimed.

The disclosed Safari navigation incident (prior clipboard content forming a Google search URL; whether a request reached Google is unverified) is a proof-operation event outside the product code path; it was accepted as disclosed, not re-investigated.

Intermediate-commit contents between base and head were not inspected beyond the aggregate frozen diff; the acceptance states post-e87843e4 commits are evidence-only, which was not independently verified.
Cross-engine clipboard payloads differ in rendered whitespace (294404 vs 294352 chars); no cross-engine byte identity was claimed or verified.

findings.title: Clipboard behavioral paths (repeat clicks, denied/absent API, both-fail, control exclusion) have no automated regression; they rest solely on recorded manual browser proof
New test test_copy_control_is_accessible_in_masthead_and_hidden_when_printing lacks the @pytest.mark.unit marker used by all sibling tests (still executes under default addopts)

escalation_reasons: Frozen scope changes more than 10 files or more than 500 lines.
